result.title: $π^4$: A Foundation Model for 4D Scene Geometry and Motion
result.summary: $π^4$ is a unified foundation model for 4D scene perception. From diverse, uncalibrated RGB observations in the wild---a single image, an unordered collection, or a video sequence---it recovers dense geometry, camera poses, and metric scale, together with 2D/3D point tracks and moving-object masks for multi-image inputs. It couples a geometry branch with a geometry-conditioned motion branch, which predicts image-space correspondences that are lifted into 3D using reconstructed target-view geometry. Across diverse benchmarks, $π^4$ achieves the best overall average rank in geometry evaluation, alongside competitive performance in single- and multiview 2D/3D point tracking and moving-object segmentation. With a shared backbone, the full geometry-and-motion system contains approximately 0.5B parameters---less than half the size of most baselines. It produces joint reconstructions and tracks in one forward pass, including large-scale scenes with thousands of input images despite training with contexts of at most 64 views. We further present the data and training recipe underlying these capabilities, together with empirical studies of key design choices. Code and models are available at https://github.com/yyfz/Pi4.

AI.brief_summary: 提出统一的 4D 场景感知基础模型：从无标定 RGB 观测（单图、无序图像集或视频）恢复稠密几何、相机位姿与度量尺度，并对多图输入输出 2D/3D 点轨迹和运动物体掩码；以几何分支加几何条件运动分支、约 0.5B 参数共享骨干，单次前向给出联合重建与轨迹。
AI.relevance_reason: 不属 LVR 主线，但其「训练仅用至多 64 视角、推理可扩展到上千张输入」的长上下文外推现象，以及用几何条件把 2D 对应关系提升到 3D 的分支设计，可能为 latent 工作区的长度泛化与几何证据注入提供可核查线索。
